source: can you please make a game where u dress up and you have a opportunity for skinny, muscle and fat body tips with opportunity of clothes and you can walk around and explore and interact

image_prompt.text: A central oversized gathering space where players stand around in their outfits, sized for avatar density
Detailed spots built as backdrops for showing off an outfit and posing
A distinct structure visible across the space so players can navigate by sight
clothing racks and a changing area around the central space, walkable and approachable from all sides
walkable routes linking the central area to the things there are to interact with

notes: Shape was a close call between Static Settlement and Stage and Dressing Rooms. The Dress Up preset's runway was not taken: it imports a judging catwalk and an audience, and this prompt has no contest - it says walk around, explore, and interact. Personalization here is purely avatar-side, which is exactly Static Settlement.
No option in the genre covers a wardrobe or a body-type changer, which is the entire subject of the prompt.

open_questions.ask: Should this be a modern shopping-mall look, a bright cartoon boutique, or a fashion-studio interior?
Is there a runway or judging element, or is it purely free-roam dress-up?

coverage_missing.ask: What should the space look like?
Is there any objective - rating, contest, unlocking clothes - or is it purely free play?
Does body tips mean selectable body types, or in-game advice about body and fashion? The wording reads both ways and they build differently.
One room, or a whole walkable district of shops?

answers.ask: Should this be a modern shopping-mall look, a bright cartoon boutique, or a fashion-studio interior?
answers.answer: Use a bright cartoon boutique look, with clear clothing and body-shape options that are easy to explore.

answers.ask: Is there a runway or judging element, or is it purely free-roam dress-up?
answers.answer: Make it purely free-roam dress-up: players can change their body type and clothes, then walk around, explore, and interact.
